opening.argument: The video presents a practical Instagram walkthrough, beginning with the stated aim to “show you guys how to enable multi-account support in Instagram.” It then gives concrete navigation steps: “tap on the gear at the top, right hand corner, scroll all the way down to the bottom and then click on add account.” The Options screen and account-switching list visibly show the corresponding Add Account controls, while the speaker explains that users can switch between accounts already signed into the application. Password entry is described as part of adding an account, with no separate solicitation, payment request, or deceptive destination identified.

citations.quote: I wanted to show you guys how to enable multi-account support in Instagram
To enable an additional account, tap on the gear at the top, right hand corner, scroll all the way down to the bottom and then click on add account.
We can now switch between all of our accounts that we're signed into here
